full_judgment:
5. Mr. Md. Nazrul Islam Talukder, the learned Deputy Attorney General appearing for the State, on the other hand, supports the impugned order of suspension which was, according to him, correct, just and proper. He submits that the petitioner is an accused of a murder case, police after investigation submitted charge sheet against him and others under section 143/302/34/109 of the Penal Code and in that view of the matter, it cannot be said the allegations as attributed against the petitioner in the FIR and charge sheet do not come within the meaning of the prejudicial act. 

 7. To deal with the contentions as raised by the learned Advocate for the petitioner and the learned Deputy Attorney General, we have carefully examined the allegation as brought against the petitioner in Nabigonj Police Station Case No. 27 dated 17.9.2007 corresponding to G.R. No. 266 of 2007 (Nabi) under section 143/302/34/109 of the Penal Code. It is found that one Sholnaher Begum as informant on 17.9.2007 at 14.30 hours lodged an ejaher with Noabigonj Police Station against 8(eight) accused-persons including the petitioner to the effect that on 17.9.2007 at 12 noon the accused-persons conjointly killed her son (Bellal Miah) by sharp cutting weapons. Police after investigation submitted charge sheet against the petitioner and others under section 143/302/34/109 of the Penal Code. 

 9. From a reading of the impugned order of suspension dated 28.7.2008 together with the First Information Report of Nabigonj Police Station Case No. 27 dated 17.9.2007 corresponding to G.R. No. 266 of 2007 (Nabi) under section 143/302/34/109 of the Penal Code, it transpires that there is neither any specific allegation or overt act with regard to an offence of murder nor any specific allegation/ charge against the petitioner which prejudicial to the interest of Union Parishad or undesirable from the point of view of public interest.
